name: superstacks
description: Use for planning, TDD, verification loops, constraints, gardening, review, PRs, debugging, and ticket pipelines. Lean MIT skill stack for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Superstacks is a small MIT-licensed set of coding-agent skills: discovery, plans in the pull request body, test-driven development, verify-loop, verification before any success claim, two-axis review, draft pull requests, optional interrogate for one-way doors, constraints, gardening, and design grilling. The plugin runs, sends, and fetches nothing.
